criteria_location: POSITION STATEMENT, pp.2-5, in four layers: (a) numbered subsections (1)-(6) paraphrasing Florida Administrative Code Chapter 59-B; (b) 'also meets the definition of medical necessity' additional indications (small lymphocytic lymphoma, Hodgkin, myeloma tandem, MPN); (c) a case-by-case paragraph with open examples; (d) an investigational list. Cord-blood and cord-blood banking statements close the section. Reimbursement says only 'Refer to section entitled POSITION STATEMENT'.
procedures_covered: Allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (bone marrow / peripheral blood / cord blood) by disease

logic.top_level: pathways: a disease list (item (1)), a trial-only list (2), a rare-disease list (3), a donor-type rule (4), an outside-trial route (5) and further indications, each a separate route to coverage

k_of_n.quote: Allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation is covered when performed for one of the following indications:

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Separate 'experimental or investigational for the following indications' list (advanced epithelial ovarian cancer, autoimmune diseases, adult and pediatric solid tumors, ependymoma, germ cell tumors, CNS embryonal tumors, etc.). No patient-level contraindication list. Some diseases appear in both covered and investigational lists with qualifiers (multiple myeloma, POEMS).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Not addressed except tandem transplantation for myeloma and Hodgkin 'after autologous stem cell collection failure or relapsed after autologous transplant'. No re-transplant criteria.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: 5. Any bone marrow transplant performed outside of a clinical trial will be covered when all the following criteria are met: The plan of care follows a clinical trial protocol that meets the requirements of subsection (5);
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Item 5 refers to 'subsection (5)', which is itself; the trial definition is item 6, so the cross-reference looks mis-numbered.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Sickle cell anemia, thalassemia, and other severe red cell disorders
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Appears under item (1) (covered outright) and again under item (2) (covered only in a clinical trial); it is unclear which route applies.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Multiple myeloma, as initial therapy for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma, or as salvage therapy [except as noted in subsection (2) above]
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Listed as investigational, with a carve-out by cross-reference to (2) and a covered tandem route later; the net answer requires combining three places.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: there are generally accepted and appropriate indications for bone marrow transplantation in these cases ... may be determined on a case by case basis
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Open-ended indications with no criteria: reviewer judgment.

extraction_hazards: Stray word from conversion: '[(1) – (6)]:multiple' in the lead sentence.
Sub-items use U+F0B7 private-use bullets (49) that vanish in many viewers; indentation under numbered items shifts between pages.
Items are numbered '1.' to '6.' in the text but the document cross-refers to them as '(1)'-'(6)' and 'subsections'; item numbers also appear as inline subsection refs inside other bullets.

Page-break inside the numbered list; the Certificate of Medical Necessity instruction block (with its own '1. 2. 3.' numbered steps) sits at the start of the Position Statement and could be mistaken for criteria.
References run 146 entries (pp.10-19), ~360 lines; Update Information is also a long dated log.
Statutory excerpts under OTHER are legal text, not criteria, but contain 'shall'/'may not' language.
interesting_structures: Criteria are layered by legal source: state-mandated floor (59-B subsections) then Florida Blue's additional indications 'in addition to any mandated coverage in subsections 1-6 above'.
Clinical-trial gating: some indications covered only inside an NCI-consistent IRB protocol, with a route for patients who cannot enroll.
Facility network requirement (BMT CTN core/non-core center).
Blanket 'case by case' acknowledgement for diseases not enumerated.
Same disease can be covered, trial-only and investigational in three different lists.

fit_to_tree.why: it is a disease-indexed table plus gating conditions (trial, facility, donor match) with cross-references and a reviewer-discretion clause; needs a disease lookup and a notion of 'covered via route X', and some leaves ('appropriate candidate') are pure judgment.
